title: Circadian vulnerability in acute myocardial infarction: from clock-regulated pathways to chrono-individualized therapy.
snippet: Acute myocardial infarction (AMI) is a leading cause of morbidity and mortality worldwide, and its onset, progression, and prognosis are closely tied to circadian rhythms. title: Multispectral Optoacoustic Tomography Noninvasively Reveals Ultrastructural Muscle Changes and Associates With Clinical Disability in Inclusion Body Myositis.
